vector_memory.semantic_summary: AudioCache is a framework-agnostic service responsible for managing audio assets, providing RAM caching for short clips and streaming capabilities for long-form content. It utilizes an internal Map for O(1) lookups and supports optional Least Recently Used (LRU) eviction based on a configurable memory ceiling. Core functionality involves asynchronous fetching via 'fetch', decoding via 'AudioContext', and managing stream lifecycles using 'HTMLAudioElement'.
